content: ibus-daemon kills itself when an engine process exits abnormally (TUX IM dev log part 2, June 2026: 8 pitfalls in ~2 weeks, nearly all triggered daemon suicide). ibus-daemon restart kills engine children; engines are spawned on demand when the source becomes active (verified locally: test engine spawned ~2s after activation). Every key arrives twice (press + release with IBUS_RELEASE_MASK 0x40000000) - filter releases at the single top-of-dispatch entry point or letters double. No exception/error may escape the engine process; log at the dispatch boundary.
